CustomField.description: Owner of new Zoom Leads: active users whose User Department equals this value AND whose Role and Profile match the two Lead Owner fields. Several matching users = round-robin (oldest user first). Any of the three blank, or no matching user = the owner set by the Lead trigger is kept.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: User Department, e.g. Undergraduation. All three Lead Owner fields must be filled.
CustomField.label: Lead Owner Department
